summary: Implemented the terminal window title feature. Changes: rich/segment.py adds SET_WINDOW_TITLE = 16 and a Tuple[ControlType, str] member in ControlCode; rich/control.py adds the formatting entry (\x1b]0;{title}\x07) and the Control.title classmethod; rich/console.py adds Console.set_window_title beside show_cursor, gated only on is_terminal; rich/_windows_renderer.py adds a branch calling term.set_title(title); CHANGELOG.md gets one Unreleased Added bullet linking PR 2200. Tests added to existing modules: test_set_window_title (tests/test_console.py), test_control_title (tests/test_control.py), test_control_set_window_title (tests/test_windows_renderer.py, Windows-only). Nothing was run or committed, and Black formatting was not verified.
